title: Mochizuki Honami — Welcome To The Nightmare〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Lunch time♪ Lunch time♪
What to have for lunch time...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Emu. Are you free now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Time to dig in☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's nice to get to eat lunch with Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Doesn't this wonderful sunshine make you feel like we're on a picnic?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And isn't this the first time that we've ever lunch together? You know, just the two of us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, except that time we had apple pies together at that bakery!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It wasn't even that long ago,
but it somehow feels nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, I wanted to thank you for showing me your amazing show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The last time we went to Phoenix Wonderland was so long ago, we all just let the kid inside of us sort of take over.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe. That's okay, you were having fun!
Come and play again anytime!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's almost like you're inviting me over to your house.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But since her family owns the theme park, maybe it is her home in a way.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And it must be a very important place to her, judging from how she guided us through the park so thoroughly.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu, maybe you won't remember since it was a while ago...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you once snuck up on me in the corridor and really startled me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup, I remember! You had the best reaction too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ahh?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What... Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gotcha!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess it was funny.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you remember what you asked me after that? About why I looked so upset?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... I was in the brass band in middle school, so I had a trip down memory lane, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
That's all. Really.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope my smile is convincing enough...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I said I was just lost in some memories, but that was a lie.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Back then I was avoiding Saki and the others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's a long story, but would you mind listening?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course not!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Back in junior high, my classmates would often ask me for advice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wanted to be helpful to all of them, but they accused me of being insincere and pretending to be everyone's friend to avoid choosing sides.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They started bullying me by pretending I didn't exist.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika noticed what was happening and became really worried about me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I was too scared to ask her for help,
and I ended up avoiding her instead...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That carried through into high school...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That day you startled me and asked about it,
Saki also tried to talk to me. Several times too,
but I ran away every time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Like you said, it made me upset. Really upset... And I hated myself for treating Saki that way too, but just couldn't help it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But when you asked me if I was really okay, I felt so happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Telling you about it made me feel so much better.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Back then, I couldn't get myself to tell anyone the truth...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm really grateful that you tried to reach out to me, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe!
You’re super duper welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, and one more thing.
I finally fulfilled our promise too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami!
Once our show's ready, you have to come watch, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then you'll definitely be able to smile from the heart!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did smile from the heart watching your show, like you said.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So thank you for that too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No probs♪
You're super duper extra welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll keep putting on more shows to make more and more people smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So you'll have to come again and again and again to see us on stage!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I promise I will!
